name: total_pips
definition: Expected production numerator: cards per roll = pips / 36, ignoring robber and bank shortage.
formula: sum_r P_r(v)

name: wood_pips
definition: Candidate settlement production pips for wood.
formula: P_wood(v): sum of pip(number) over touching wood hexes

name: brick_pips
definition: Candidate settlement production pips for brick.
formula: P_brick(v): sum of pip(number) over touching brick hexes

name: sheep_pips
definition: Candidate settlement production pips for sheep.
formula: P_sheep(v): sum of pip(number) over touching sheep hexes

name: wheat_pips
definition: Candidate settlement production pips for wheat.
formula: P_wheat(v): sum of pip(number) over touching wheat hexes

name: ore_pips
definition: Candidate settlement production pips for ore.
formula: P_ore(v): sum of pip(number) over touching ore hexes

name: adjacent_hexes
definition: Number of touching hexes, including desert; coastal/interior control.
formula: count of all hexes touching v, including desert

name: local_resource_count
definition: Distinct producing resources touched by this candidate.
formula: sum_r 1[P_r(v) > 0]

name: new_resource_types
definition: Resources added that existing own settlements do not produce.
formula: sum_r 1[P_r(v) > 0 and O_r = 0]

name: new_resource_pips
definition: Candidate pips in resources missing from existing own settlements.
formula: sum_r P_r(v) * 1[O_r = 0]

name: combined_resource_count
definition: Distinct resources after adding this candidate to existing own settlements.
formula: sum_r 1[C_r(v) > 0]

name: all_five_covered
definition: One if the combined own portfolio produces all five resources.
formula: 1[all five C_r(v) > 0]

name: combined_total_pips
definition: Sum of candidate and existing own settlement pips, counting each settlement.
formula: sum_r C_r(v)

name: combined_concentration_hhi
definition: Sum of squared resource shares; 1 means one-resource concentration, 0.2 means five equal shares.
formula: sum_r (C_r(v) / sum_s C_s(v))^2; zero if total is zero

name: combined_resource_entropy
definition: Natural-log entropy of combined resource pip shares; zero when concentrated in one resource.
formula: -sum_r q_r log(q_r), q_r = C_r / sum_s C_s; zero shares contribute zero

name: combined_wood_pips
definition: Own portfolio production pips after adding the candidate for wood.
formula: C_wood(v) = P_wood(v) + O_wood

name: wood_starting_cards
definition: Cards of this resource granted immediately if this is the actor's second settlement; first placements receive zero.
formula: count of touching producing wood hexes if this is the actor's second settlement; otherwise 0

name: combined_brick_pips
definition: Own portfolio production pips after adding the candidate for brick.
formula: C_brick(v) = P_brick(v) + O_brick

name: brick_starting_cards
definition: Cards of this resource granted immediately if this is the actor's second settlement; first placements receive zero.
formula: count of touching producing brick hexes if this is the actor's second settlement; otherwise 0

name: combined_sheep_pips
definition: Own portfolio production pips after adding the candidate for sheep.
formula: C_sheep(v) = P_sheep(v) + O_sheep

name: sheep_starting_cards
definition: Cards of this resource granted immediately if this is the actor's second settlement; first placements receive zero.
formula: count of touching producing sheep hexes if this is the actor's second settlement; otherwise 0

name: combined_wheat_pips
definition: Own portfolio production pips after adding the candidate for wheat.
formula: C_wheat(v) = P_wheat(v) + O_wheat

name: wheat_starting_cards
definition: Cards of this resource granted immediately if this is the actor's second settlement; first placements receive zero.
formula: count of touching producing wheat hexes if this is the actor's second settlement; otherwise 0

name: combined_ore_pips
definition: Own portfolio production pips after adding the candidate for ore.
formula: C_ore(v) = P_ore(v) + O_ore

name: ore_starting_cards
definition: Cards of this resource granted immediately if this is the actor's second settlement; first placements receive zero.
formula: count of touching producing ore hexes if this is the actor's second settlement; otherwise 0

name: direct_port
definition: One if the candidate touches any port.
formula: 1[v is a corner served by any port]

name: generic_port
definition: One if the candidate touches a generic 3:1 port.
formula: 1[v is a corner served by a generic 3:1 port]

name: wood_port
definition: One if the candidate touches the wood 2:1 port.
formula: 1[v is served by the specialized wood 2:1 port]

name: brick_port
definition: One if the candidate touches the brick 2:1 port.
formula: 1[v is served by the specialized brick 2:1 port]

name: sheep_port
definition: One if the candidate touches the sheep 2:1 port.
formula: 1[v is served by the specialized sheep 2:1 port]

name: wheat_port
definition: One if the candidate touches the wheat 2:1 port.
formula: 1[v is served by the specialized wheat 2:1 port]

name: ore_port
definition: One if the candidate touches the ore 2:1 port.
formula: 1[v is served by the specialized ore 2:1 port]

name: port_matching_combined_pips
definition: Combined own pips in the specialized port resource, zero unless this candidate directly touches that port.
formula: C_r(v) if v directly touches the specialized r port; otherwise 0

name: nearest_port_distance
definition: Shortest geometric edge distance from this candidate to any port corner; ignores ownership, road direction, cost and blocking.
formula: min_{u served by any port} d(v,u)

name: nearest_generic_port_distance
definition: Shortest geometric edge distance to any generic 3:1 port corner.
formula: min_{u served by a generic port} d(v,u)

name: wood_port_distance
definition: Shortest geometric edge distance to the wood port.
formula: min_{u served by wood port} d(v,u)

name: brick_port_distance
definition: Shortest geometric edge distance to the brick port.
formula: min_{u served by brick port} d(v,u)

name: sheep_port_distance
definition: Shortest geometric edge distance to the sheep port.
formula: min_{u served by sheep port} d(v,u)

name: wheat_port_distance
definition: Shortest geometric edge distance to the wheat port.
formula: min_{u served by wheat port} d(v,u)

name: ore_port_distance
definition: Shortest geometric edge distance to the ore port.
formula: min_{u served by ore port} d(v,u)

name: matched_port_potential
definition: Maximum over resources of combined resource pips / (1 + geometric port distance); already owned ports use distance zero. A descriptive interaction, not a trade-value model.
formula: max_r C_r(v) / (1 + D_r(v)); D_r = geometric distance to resource-r port, or 0 if already owned

name: unique_local_numbers
definition: Distinct dice outcomes producing cards at this candidate.
formula: sum_n 1[c_n(v) > 0]

name: unique_combined_numbers
definition: Distinct dice outcomes producing cards for the combined own portfolio.
formula: sum_n 1[c_n(v) + o_n > 0]

name: pips_overlapping_owned_numbers
definition: Candidate pips on number outcomes already collected by an own settlement.
formula: sum_n c_n(v) * 1[o_n > 0] * pip(n)

name: combined_production_variance
definition: Variance in total cards per roll, counting shared numbers exactly; ignores robber and bank shortage.
formula: sum_n q_n (c_n(v)+o_n)^2 - (sum_n q_n (c_n(v)+o_n))^2

name: combined_zero_production_probability
definition: Probability of collecting zero cards on a dice roll, including seven; ignores robber and bank shortage.
formula: sum_n q_n * 1[c_n(v)+o_n = 0], including n=7

name: best_expansion_pips_two_roads
definition: Highest-pip currently distance-rule-open corner exactly two geometric edges away; excludes cost, direction and competition.
formula: max total_pips(u) over d(v,u)=2 and u currently open by the settlement distance rule; 0 if no such u

name: opponent_proximity
definition: 1/(1 + closest opponent settlement edge distance); zero if no opponent settlement yet.
formula: 1 / (1 + min_{u opponent settlement} d(v,u)); 0 if none

name: own_proximity
definition: 1/(1 + closest own settlement edge distance); zero if no own settlement yet.
formula: 1 / (1 + min_{u own settlement} d(v,u)); 0 if none

name: desert_adjacency
definition: One if this candidate touches the desert.
formula: 1[any hex touching v is desert]
